name: EvenNode
line: Host Node.js and Python apps with managed runtime tools.

free.text: Signup trial; ongoing free hosting allowance not established

cells.regions: Europe and US; cities not listed

work.math: €4.50 a month before VAT, if counted app storage stays up to 2 GB and total traffic stays within the 2 TB soft limit. Extra disk is billed separately.
€34 a month for the tier with 2 GB and 50 processes is a possible option. The standard tier's vCPU allocation is not published, so whether 1 vCPU fits is not verified.
€34 a month for the app example, plus outside PostgreSQL with at least 1 GiB and 10 GB, daily 7-day backups and transfer. Whether the provider and CPU fit is unknown.
